Rationale: Identity and authentication cannot be foreign-hosted under any sovereignty posture; loss of control here is loss of the ability to establish who exists.
Core administrative services are the state's operational continuity; they move first and they do not move back.
SOC telemetry and threat intelligence carry clearance constraints and reveal national defensive posture in aggregate.
Classified compute is jurisdiction-bound by law in every member state; no commercial tier is admissible.
Registries, cadastre and national datasets. The Tier 0/1 identity and legal record lives here; see TIER0-TIER1-SIZING.md.
Model serving is an economic-policy choice rather than a continuity requirement; hybrid-eligible where an in-jurisdiction commercial region exists.
Scientific and public research workloads are the most readily burst to commercial capacity and the least sovereignty-critical.
